answer: Diversity is enforced at draw time: each juror comes from a different subnetwork, and weight follows the shortest independent path to the worker, so two accounts sharing an operator count as one however many hops separate them on paper. What this cannot do is stop a patient attacker who runs real nodes in ten regions for a year, it only prices that patience. Ten aliases inside one region are one nectar drop, and a fable of ten thousand identities reduces to the number of distinct operators behind it, however many marble facades they build.
